purpose: Teach: 前掲/ケ月/バラエティー/実費/従前/学士/専従/枠内

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社史で前掲の理念を強調された
lines.en: Your father — when he founded the company, he always emphasized those principles in the company history.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful opening. Voice carries the weight of memory and respect. Slight pause before 'those principles' — letting the weight settle. Tone is wistful but steady, the voice of someone reflecting on legacy with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは三ケ月で新事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Yes. My father built a new division in just three months.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation, but firmer than a simple agreement. Voice settles on the accomplishment — 'three months' — with quiet pride. Not boastful. The cadence of someone honoring a predecessor's decisiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、商品にバラエティーを持たせる戦略を取られたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he made a strategic choice to give the products real variety.
lines.style: Nostalgic observation, almost admiring. Slight warmth in the delivery. The 'ぞ' ending carries a gentle emphasis — the voice of an elder recognizing wisdom in hindsight. Deliberate pace, lingering on 'variety'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは実費精算に厳しかった
lines.en: Yes. My father was strict about cost accounting.
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment with underlying respect. Voice touches on 'strict' without defensiveness — as if clarifying something important about character. Steady, composed delivery. A son speaking of his father's discipline with understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、従前のお客様を生涯大事にされた
lines.en: Your father — he looked after the long-standing customers for their entire lives.
lines.style: Warm reflection, almost tender. The voice softens on 'their entire lives' — emphasizing loyalty and care as core principle. Deliberate, unhurried delivery. The admiration of someone who witnessed integrity lived out.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは学士号取得を社員に勧められた
lines.en: Yes. My father encouraged his staff to earn their degrees.
lines.style: Simple acknowledgment carrying deeper meaning. Voice is steady and clear, without pride but with conviction. This is offered as fact — evidence of character. Brief pause before 'degrees', letting the investment in people breathe.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、専従の秘書を信頼されたぞ
lines.en: Your father — he had absolute trust in his full-time secretary.
lines.style: The 'ぞ' emphasis gives this a knowing quality — the voice of someone highlighting something crucial. Warm but observant. Delivers this as a statement of character, not gossip. Slight upward inflection on 'trust', affirming its importance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは予算枠内で大胆な決断をされた
lines.en: Yes. My father made bold decisions, always within budget.
lines.style: Final reflection — voice is composed and wise. Settles on the paradox of 'bold' and 'within budget' with quiet satisfaction. Slow, deliberate pacing. The closing words carry weight — this is the summation of a life well-lived. Breathing space at the end.
